main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on forecast, case days summed
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 (with mean excess > 0) confirms; slope t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess next-day return over case bars > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean excess next-day return over the cases is above 0.
reading: Situation recomputed as close[t]/close[t-1]-1 < 0 and volume / mean of the 20 prior volumes > 1 (recorded heavy_vol raw value + 1 where present), active bars without a computable situation (first bars of a window) left out; cases with the same UTC day are summed (both excess return and forecast) into one observation for an OLS slope t; the plan's 300-day minimum, if not reached, gives 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0005981 on the check folds against +0.0007394 on every fold
